text:
Situation: Levetiracetam 100 mg/mL 5 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across three sites provides 18.2 to 26.8 days on hand based on recent daily usage. No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our current inventory.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include levetiracetam as of 2026-10-21. The top-ranked supplier, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, was last inspected and classified VAI on 2023-10-13. Alternate manufacturers Hospira, Inc., Mylan Institutional LLC, Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC, and UCB, Inc. are also not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. We will maintain current purchasing from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as the primary source and keep alternate manufacturers qualified for rapid activation if needed.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer continues routine procurement from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; Pharmacy Director approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer maintains qualified alternate agreements with Hospira, Inc., Mylan Institutional LLC, Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC, and UCB, Inc.; Pharmacy Director approves contracts.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list and supplier communications weekly; Pharmacy Director reviews reports.
4. Inventory analyst tracks days on hand at each site and alerts buyer if any site falls below 14 days; Pharmacy Director approves redistribution plan.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
